definition_en: To obtain or secure (something wanted or desirable).

examples.en: You will gain a lot of experience.

definition_en: Showing a readiness to give more of something, as money or time, than is strictly necessary or expected.
definition_telugu: ఖచ్చితంగా అవసరమైన లేదా ఊహించిన దానికంటే ఎక్కువ డబ్బు లేదా సమయం వంటివి ఇవ్వడానికి సంసిద్ధతను చూపడం.

examples.en: It was generous of him to pay for everyone.
